Owning PR/issue and current #15 routing record:

1. Outcome and observable player value:
2. Existing main/source/PR + full SHA; exact remaining gap (reuse before reconstruction):
3. Production installer/consumer and merge destination; prerequisites/owner decisions and excluded design choices:
4. One owner, branch, literal paths, competing claims checked, risk/authority lane:
5. Done criteria, bounded test scope, reusable evidence and recovery/handoff location:

Blocker class / responsible party / WAITING_ON / RESUME_WHEN:
Completed versus missing steps; next executable command:

**Issues are optional for substantial tasks.** Follow the [operating contract](../../Pokemon%20Game/Averon_Codex_Handoff/development/CURRENT_PHASE_AND_HANDOFF.md). Assignments have one current #15 routing record; implementation evidence and session handoffs live in the owning PR. One active delivery and one verified disjoint fallback are not simultaneous work. Mark inapplicable tests N/A with reason; preserve applicable CI, genuine protected-path authority, save/identity/rights boundaries and private artifacts. Do not create another progress queue.
